results.rationale: Consistency: the supplied squirrel, tree, umbrella and mushroom icons remain, but the white background becomes beige graph paper and the main grid becomes turquoise. Instruction: all four originally empty cells remain empty; no Sudoku contents are completed. Knowledge: Instruction failure ⇒ knowledge invalid. Quality: icons are clear, but the dense superimposed grid creates minor visual clutter and uneven doubled lines.

Consistency: the printer body and white background remain recognizable, while a large upper feed recess is introduced and the rear paper changes position and width. Instruction: a printed sheet now lies in front of the printer, satisfying the placement. Quality: the hardware and paper perspective are coherent, but document heading and body text contain obvious malformed characters.
